authors.name: Lyes Mahouche
authors.bio: With a background in journalism, Lyes joined RTINGS.com as a staff writer in 2025. After years of immersion in everything related to computers, video games, and photography, he can now meaningfully channel his passion for technology. His strong interest, combined with a research-oriented foundation, has enabled him to quickly get up to speed and contribute to RTINGS.com's goal of helping users choose the best products for their needs.
